problem_description: the mptcp_join.sh selftest incorrectly expects 2 MP_JOIN ACKs instead of 3 on older kernels
The seqpacket message bounds test hangs because the sender fills the TX buffer before waking up the receiver.
AMT tests fail because packets are sent before the tunnel connection is established or the listener socket is ready.
The test suite fails to detect available vsock transports because it strictly filters for symbols of type 'd' in /proc/kallsyms.
The s390 vDSO selftest fails to compile because the include path refers to the old `vdso64` directory instead of the renamed `vdso` directory.
The fib-onlink-tests fail if the system under test already has a default IPv6 route configured.
The gup_longterm selftest fails on unknown filesystems because it returns early without reporting the test result.
missing selftests for forked faulted/unfaulted VMA merges
The toeplitz.py test passes the RPS mask without a '0x' prefix to toeplitz.c, causing it to be parsed as decimal instead of hexadecimal.
The KUnit test suite for the Cirrus side-codec library was incorrectly named 'snd-hda-scodec-cs35l56-test' instead of 'snd-hda-cirrus-scodec-test'.
The cirrus_scodec_test KUnit test fails to associate the software node with the GPIO driver because the mock gpio_chip does not have its parent device set.
If the last test fails, the other side still completes correctly, leading to false positive results.
Link failures occur when IOMMU_PT_AMDV1 is configured as a module while IOMMUFD is built-in, causing undefined references in the selftest.
The iommufd selftest fails to build due to missing DMA_SHARED_BUFFER Kconfig selection.
kunit tests fail to build because GENERIC_PT is unselectable without COMPILE_TEST enabled
The test_multiple_writes test stalls when the tracing buffer size is less than 12KB due to insufficient buffer space.
The server file descriptor srv_fd is leaked in the named_unix_domain_socket_ioctl test.
A syntax error in scripts/crypto/gen-hash-testvecs.py causes build failures with older Python versions due to improper quoting in an f-string.
The KUnit test test_polyval_preparekey_in_irqs fails on fast machines because the iteration count is too low to guarantee IRQ execution.
the main install target incorrectly installs test artifacts
The 'tool' module is missing from the net selftests library imports, causing ImportErrors in tests.
The doctest line number anchor was not updated when adding an `#![allow]` attribute, resulting in off-by-one line numbers in KUnit test output.
The func_traceonoff_triggers test fails because the md5sum check is sensitive to non-deterministic task name resolution updates in the trace output even when tracing is paused.
Missing semicolon after EXPECT_EQ statement in the scoped_vs_unscoped test.
The `test-all` feature test always fails to link because the `-lssl` flag is missing.
The named_unix_domain_socket_ioctl test calls bind() with an uninitialized sun_path, causing random test failures due to reading stack garbage.
The bind(AF_UNSPEC) test incorrectly expects -EINVAL instead of -EAFNOSUPPORT on IPv6 sockets and uses an insufficient address length.
The uffd-unit-tests selftest fails on 32-bit architectures because it uses sizeof on a pointer instead of strlen to calculate a string offset.
The basic perf top coverage test is flaky and fails to capture samples when running in parallel with other tests due to system load.
The test fails with a false positive buffer overflow error when compiled with _FORTIFY_SOURCE=3, and the IFLA_IFNAME attribute was incorrectly sent without null termination.
The test case name is not visible to ksft_run because it is assigned inside the test function execution rather than during its creation.
Templated test names in psp_ip_ver_test_builder are not visible to the test runner because the test_case.__name__ assignment occurs during test execution rather than at construction time.
KUnit interrupt tests may fail if the main task finishes before interrupts execute, execution counters lack atomicity, and assertion messages are overly specific.
Empty busy wait loops in hardirq test functions cause objtool warnings regarding unexpected section ends when building with Clang on x86_64.
The KHO test module accesses uninitialized internal data structures because it fails to check if KHO is enabled before issuing commands.
